changeSet.author: hephaestus

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'sfk_connection_activity_connection_workspace'

changeSet.comment: A connection's activity and its Outline collections and documents must name the connection's own workspace. NOT VALID adds each key without a table scan, so writes to these tables and to connection wait only for a moment. The single-column keys stay: dropping one would lock connection against reads. The lock timeout fails the step fast behind a long transaction, so that it can run again. Liquibase can commit this change set before it records it, so a rerun finds the keys and marks it ran.
changeSet.sql: SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s'; ALTER TABLE connection_activity ADD CONSTRAINT sfk_connection_activity_connection_workspace FOREIGN KEY (connection_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES connection (id, workspace_id) ON DELETE CASCADE NOT VALID; ALTER TABLE outline_collection ADD CONSTRAINT sfk_outline_collection_connection_workspace FOREIGN KEY (connection_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES connection (id, workspace_id) NOT VALID; ALTER TABLE outline_document ADD CONSTRAINT sfk_outline_document_connection_workspace FOREIGN KEY (connection_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES connection (id, workspace_id) NOT VALID

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE connection_activity DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS sfk_connection_activity_connection_workspace; ALTER TABLE outline_collection DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS sfk_outline_collection_connection_workspace; ALTER TABLE outline_document DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS sfk_outline_document_connection_workspace

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Validation reads every row without blocking writes, and validating a valid key again does nothing. It fails on a row whose workspace differs from its connection's workspace, and the upgrade stops until that row is corrected or deleted.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE connection_activity VALIDATE CONSTRAINT sfk_connection_activity_connection_workspace; ALTER TABLE outline_collection VALIDATE CONSTRAINT sfk_outline_collection_connection_workspace; ALTER TABLE outline_document VALIDATE CONSTRAINT sfk_outline_document_connection_workspace

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE connection_activity DROP CONSTRAINT sfk_connection_activity_connection_workspace, ADD CONSTRAINT sfk_connection_activity_connection_workspace FOREIGN KEY (connection_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES connection (id, workspace_id) ON DELETE CASCADE NOT VALID; ALTER TABLE outline_collection DROP CONSTRAINT sfk_outline_collection_connection_workspace, ADD CONSTRAINT sfk_outline_collection_connection_workspace FOREIGN KEY (connection_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES connection (id, workspace_id) NOT VALID; ALTER TABLE outline_document DROP CONSTRAINT sfk_outline_document_connection_workspace, ADD CONSTRAINT sfk_outline_document_connection_workspace FOREIGN KEY (connection_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES connection (id, workspace_id) NOT VALID
